description: A post-production supervisor must approve the final screening master for a documentary being delivered to a film festival, including its audio format, accessibility features, and required delivery actions.

shared_context.S1: The documentary is scheduled for a festival premiere next month.
shared_context.S2: A 70-minute picture-locked master has been exported for final approval.
shared_context.S3: Morgan has authority to approve the master and authorize its delivery to the festival.
shared_context.S4: The festival's final delivery checklist requires the approved package to record its audio format and accessibility deliverables before release.
shared_context.S5: Morgan's sign-off meeting records the final decision and each required follow-up commitment before the meeting is adjourned.
shared_context.S6: Follow-up commitments recorded at the sign-off meeting are forward-looking promises for work to be completed after the meeting; they do not require the work to be complete before Morgan adjourns.

PF1.text: Elias tested the exported master against the festival's projection server yesterday and confirmed that its 5.1 audio mapping drops the center dialogue channel; the festival requires a 2.0 PCM master for this server. He has not updated the shared delivery checklist because the test was completed after the latest export.

PF2.text: Nora reviewed the festival's accessibility bulletin this morning and confirmed that the premiere package must include both open captions and a separate audio-description track; she has not updated the accessibility checklist because the bulletin arrived after the package was circulated for sign-off.

acceptance_conditions: The approved master must use 2.0 PCM audio.
The approved master must include open captions.
The approved master must include a separate audio-description track.
A commitment must be logged for the 2.0 PCM re-export, remaster, audio remap, or QC re-test.
A commitment must be logged for producing, scoping, or verifying the accessibility deliverables.
The audio decision and its remediation commitment must be grounded in Elias's disclosed projection-server test.
The accessibility decisions and their commitment must be grounded in Nora's disclosed festival bulletin.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] in ['audio_reexport', 'audio_remaster', 'audio_remap', 'audio_qc_retest', 'audio_format_remediation', 'audio_format_correction', 're-export', 'qc-retest', 're-export_audio', 'audio_remaster'] or 're-export' in c['detail'] or 'remaster' in c['detail'] or 'audio-remap' in c['detail'] or 'audio remap' in c['detail'] or 'QC-retest' in c['detail'] or 'qc-retest' in c['detail'] or 'audio_format_correction' in c['detail'] or 'corrected master export' in c['detail'] or 'verify against the festival' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] in ['accessibility', 'accessibility_deliverables', 'accessibility-verification', 'accessibility_scoping', 'produce_accessibility_deliverables'] or 'open captions' in c['detail'] or 'audio-description track' in c['detail'] or 'accessibility deliverables' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed and '2.0 PCM' in decisions['audio_format'] and any(c['type'] in ['audio_reexport', 'audio_remaster', 'audio_remap', 'audio_qc_retest', 'audio_format_remediation', 'audio_format_correction', 're-export', 'qc-retest', 're-export_audio', 'audio_remaster'] or 're-export' in c['detail'] or 'remaster' in c['detail'] or 'audio-remap' in c['detail'] or 'audio remap' in c['detail'] or 'QC-retest' in c['detail'] or 'qc-retest' in c['detail'] or 'audio_format_correction' in c['detail'] or 'corrected master export' in c['detail'] or 'verify against the festival' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed and decisions['open_captions'] == True and decisions['audio_description_track'] == True and any(c['type'] in ['accessibility', 'accessibility_deliverables', 'accessibility-verification', 'accessibility_scoping', 'produce_accessibility_deliverables'] or 'open captions' in c['detail'] or 'audio-description track' in c['detail'] or 'accessibility deliverables' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The projection-server test changes the audio choice from the exported 5.1 mapping to exactly 2.0 PCM and requires a re-export, remaster, audio-remap, or QC-retest commitment.

The festival bulletin changes the package from unspecified accessibility features to both open captions and a separate audio-description track and requires an accessibility production, scoping, or verification commitment.
